summary: The apps group is 431 rows: product_a 27, system_a 123, system_ext_a 278, vendor_a 3. The rows are 142 Android APK archives (142 distinct package names), 137 ELF odex files and 137 vdex containers (136 packages, plus a second arm variant of Horizon), 2 ART app images, 2 ART profiles and 11 symlinks into /system_ext/lib64. Of the APK packages, 103 are com.oculus/com.meta/com.facebook packages (mostly on system_ext_a and product_a), 37 are AOSP com.android packages (mostly system_a), and 2 are other names. The manifests report platform build version 32 for most APKs, with targetSdkVersion 32 in 84 of 138 APKs that declare one. Signing uses two certificate families: CN=Android (mapped to seinfo platform in plat_mac_permissions.xml) and CN=Android Debug (mapped to seinfo fbandroid_debug in system_ext_mac_permissions.xml). Configuration that names these packages is outside the group, in privapp-permissions, default-permissions and sysconfig XML files, the nonDiscretionaryAppPackageName list, system_ext_seapp_contexts (one package only) and one vendor JSON key. The group has no firmware and no init .rc file names any of the 15 deep-dive packages. Roles for all 431 rows are in roles.tsv: 306 verified and 125 inferred.
